langs.intro: Which languages the office, the documents and the floor speak, how numbers and dates are written, and how time is kept.

office.title: Office languages
office.intro: Every office screen speaks both. Both are always on in this version.
office.pick: Each person picks their own language in

documents.title: Document and e-mail languages
documents.intro: Quotes, purchase orders, DDTs, invoices and their e-mails go out in Italiano or English: in the language on the customer's or supplier's record. Below, each company's own language.
documents.label: The language of each company

formats.title: Numbers and dates
formats.intro: Each person sees numbers and dates written the way of their own language.
formats.imports: A sheet you import may write numbers either way: you say which when you upload it.

time.title: Time zones
time.intro: How the factory keeps time, and the zone of each company and site.
time.label: Time zones of the companies and sites

floor.title: Floor languages
floor.intro: The languages each site's tablets offer workers, each named in its own words. A language is added only when the worker notice in force has it: a worker reads what the floor records about them in a language they understand.
floor.noSite: No active site yet: a site's tablets offer its languages.
floor.screensNote: The floor screens have their own words in Italiano and English. A site may offer another language its worker notice has: there the screens show Italiano or English until their words in it exist. Each new language needs the Owner's list and the privacy consultant's text of the notice.
floor.noNoticeWhy: A language can be added once the notice is published.
floor.notInNoticeList: Not in the worker notice yet, so not offered: {languages}.
floor.workersElse: Workers of this site read a language it does not offer: {languages}. They see Italiano for now.

confirm.add: The site's tablets offer {language} at sign-in from now on.
confirm.remove: The site's tablets stop offering {language} at sign-in.
confirm.noWords: The floor screens show Italiano or English until their words in {language} exist; the worker notice is shown in {language}.

held.noRight: Needs the right: Manage sites, lines and stations
held.last: A site keeps at least one floor language.
held.workers_one: 1 active worker reads it: give them another language first.
held.workers_other: {count} active workers read it: give them another language first.
held.noNotice: No worker notice in force: publish it in Admin › Privacy & notices first.
held.allAdded: Every floor language is offered already.
held.noneInNotice: The worker notice in force has no other language: add one to it in Admin › Privacy & notices first.
held.notInNotice: The worker notice in force has no text in it: add it in Admin › Privacy & notices first.

problem.workers_one: {language} was not removed: 1 active worker of the site reads it. Give them another language first.
problem.workers_other: {language} was not removed: {count} active workers of the site read it. Give them another language first.
problem.notInNotice: {language} was not added: the worker notice in force has no text in it. Add it in Admin › Privacy & notices first.
problem.noNotice: {language} was not added: no worker notice is in force for this company. Publish it in Admin › Privacy & notices first.
problem.changed: Someone changed this site's floor languages meanwhile. The page was read again: check and try once more.

langs.later: A glossary of trade terms and a check of machine-translated messages come in later steps.

problem.conflict: Someone changed a company meanwhile ({count} saved before it). The page was read again: check and save once more.
